_comment: THE OP + PHASE REGISTRY — the single source of truth for what Ascend can do.
Why this file exists: every op used to be enumerated by hand in five places
hardcoded list in tests/smoke.py). Three of those were test-enforced, so adding one op meant
five edits and a red CI run to find the one you missed. tests/smoke.py now DERIVES its parity
and run-order checks from this file, so a new op is one row here plus the surfaces it names.
status: 'stable' = exercised on real data. 'beta' = built and code-checked, not yet proven on a
real run (see docs/V1-READINESS.md). Be honest here; the README's maturity claim reads from it.
